Katherine — thanks again for a productive conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view:

- Economic buyer: CFO + Head of Digital Ops (you confirmed CFO is primary for PO; you will introduce CIO for procurement gating).
- Security gate: SOC2 + data retention settings + KMS requirement (tiered access model).

2) Week 1 — SOC2 evidence pack & ingestion details (we attached SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf).
3) Week 2-5 — POC execution (2 clinical flows first, then med reconciliation).
4) Week 6 — POC review, cost model and go/no-go decision with CFO.

Asks for HealthBridge from this thread:
- Please confirm primary PO contact (name + email).
- Procurement required form (we noted procurement@healthbridge.io on the call) — can you share the template?
- Legal: any standard terms or clauses we should expect to negotiate (Andrew from Legal) — if you can share a sample, we’ll pre-check for deviations.

I attached a first-draft MAP and a short procurement checklist. I’ll loop Rishi for the SOC questions and Monica for any contract-level concerns. If that looks right, we’ll convert MAP_v1 to a shared Drive version and add milestone owners.

- We support Azure Key Vault (backed by customer-managed keys) and external HSM integrations via KMIP.
